text: 《武状元苏乞儿》里也说啦，如果百姓安居乐业，谁愿意去当乞丐？
en: As they also say in King of Beggars, if ordinary folk live and work in peace and contentment, who would ever choose to become a beggar?

text: 导致卖淫女出现的原因究竟是啥？
en: What on earth is the reason that drives women into prostitution?

text: 看了这么多回答，给我的感受就是知乎用户下沉度都下到地狱18层去了。
en: Having read so many replies, my impression is that Zhihu users have sunk to the eighteenth level of hell.

text: 孟加拉的童妓拉一天客才几美元的收入，泰国色情业很发达，但泰国也成了东南亚人口贩卖的中转站，荷兰黄色合法后，犯罪率只升没降，即便岛国的色情产业，够合规吧，一样有很多是被黑帮坑害了去干这行的。
en: Child prostitutes in Bangladesh earn only a few dollars from a full day of soliciting; Thailand's sex trade is highly developed, yet Thailand has also become a transit point for human trafficking in Southeast Asia; after the Netherlands legalised prostitution, the crime rate only went up and never fell; even the island nation's sex industry, compliant enough as it is, still has plenty of people who were lured or coerced by gangs into this trade.

text: 国内的治安环境太好了，再加上对黄的打击，让黄在国内是比较单一的灰产，实际上世界上大部分色情业猖獗的地区，黄都和赌毒连在一起，因为黑产一但成了规模都不可能单独存在，会泛生出其他的犯罪活动。
en: The domestic security environment is so good, and together with the crackdown on vice, that vice at home remains a relatively isolated grey industry; in reality, in most parts of the world where the sex trade is rampant, vice is bound up with gambling and drugs, because once an underground industry reaches a certain scale it cannot exist on its own and will give rise to other criminal activity.

text: 连正经生意都有违规乱来的时候，很多人反到认为黄色合法后的衍生出的黑帮会是大善人，搞笑
en: Even proper businesses sometimes break the rules and act recklessly, yet many people, on the contrary, believe the gangs that would spring up after legalising vice would be paragons of virtue — ridiculous.

text: 八十年代，我一位小学同学爸爸是法院院长。
en: In the 1980s, a primary-school classmate's father was the head of a court.

text: 每次出白纸红钩的宣判书，最下面都是他爸爸的名字。
en: Every time a sentencing notice went up — white paper with a red tick — his father's name was always at the very bottom.

text: 可以说，他爸爸名字所有同学都耳熟名详。
en: It is fair to say every classmate knew his father's name by heart.

text: 那时候白纸一贴就是十来张，我们一群同学看得津津有味。
en: Back then they would paste up ten or so of those notices at a time, and we classmates would read them with rapt attention.

text: 虽然不知道什么叫强奸，但是基本上都是强奸。
en: We did not know what rape was, but essentially every case was rape.

text: 看了好几年，看了这么多白纸，看到他爸爸名字不在白纸上，才不再看。
en: After reading them for several years, after seeing so many notices, we only stopped once his father's name no longer appeared on them.

text: 印象最深的，被强奸的女性，除了一位卡脖子昏迷，歹徒以为死了，抛尸丢下山崖，活过来。
en: The most vivid impression: among the raped women, there was one who was choked until she passed out, the attacker thought she was dead, threw her body down the cliff, and she came back to life.

text: 其他被强奸的女性都被杀害了。
en: The other raped women were all killed.

text: 当时所有围观宣判书的人都啧啧叫道：这女孩子命真大。
en: Back then, everyone gathered around the notices clicked their tongues and said, 'That girl's got a real charmed life.'

text: 建议所有希望卖淫合法的人先去荷兰泰国等地体验一把脆皮鸭文学再来谈论是否合法
en: I would suggest that everyone who wants prostitution legalised first go to the Netherlands, Thailand and such places to sample a bit of crispy-duck literature, and only then come and discuss whether it should be legal.

text: 一个个的无非是觉得自己不是砧板上的那块肉罢了
en: Each and every one of them simply believes they are not the slab of meat on the chopping board.

text: 男性不支持卖春
en: Men do not support prostitution.

text: 更不支持双标
en: Still less do they support double standards.

text: 包二奶不违法
en: Keeping a mistress is not against the law.

text: 单身妈妈可以落户
en: Single mothers can obtain household registration.

text: 私生子有继承权
en: Children born out of wedlock have inheritance rights.

text: 婚内出轨不违法
en: Infidelity within marriage is not illegal.

text: 婚内出轨生子不违法
en: Having a child as a result of marital infidelity is not illegal.

text: 你反驳啥？
en: What exactly are you objecting to?

text: 上面有你的功劳？
en: Did you have any part in the things listed above?

text: 不是有卖淫合法的国家么？
en: Aren't there countries where prostitution is legal?

text: 去那里就好了呀。
en: Then just go there.

text: 是没长腿吗？
en: Haven't you got legs?

text: 台湾有一个组织叫做爱天使。
en: In Taiwan there is an organisation called Love Angels.

text: 她们把性也当做救济慈善的一环。
en: They also regard sex as part of their charitable relief work.

text: 她们的慈善行为，简单点说就是。
en: Their charitable work, to put it simply, is this:

text: 一个漂亮的美眉，会主动上门用手或口，替残障无法出行，且没有女朋友的男性青年进行一次生理释放。
en: A pretty young woman will proactively come to the home of a disabled young man who cannot go out and has no girlfriend, and with her hand or mouth help him achieve a physical release.

text: 我认为她们是天使，当之无愧。
en: I believe they are angels, and rightly deserve the name.

text: 很好反驳，但是反驳不了。
en: It is easy to disagree with, yet impossible to refute.

text: 这个问题下，反驳卖淫合法的论据大致有两类；
en: Under this question, the arguments against legalising prostitution fall into roughly two categories;

text: 论据一是反问是否愿意让自己的家人（老公/老婆）卖淫嫖娼；
en: The first argument is to ask, in return, whether you would be willing to let your own family (husband or wife) sell sex or visit prostitutes;

text: 论据二是说明卖淫嫖娼会滋生其他犯罪。
en: The second argument is to point out that prostitution and soliciting breed other crimes.

text: 首先从这两个论据来看，大家至少有一个共识，那就是卖淫嫖娼行为一般不会对外人（其他第三者） 造成伤害。
en: First, from these two arguments we can at least reach a consensus: that engaging in prostitution generally does not cause harm to outsiders (third parties).

text: 然后我们回头看一下这两个论据。
en: Now let us revisit these two arguments.

text: 我认为这两个反驳的论据都很有说服力，至少很能说服我。
en: I find both of these counter-arguments very persuasive, or at least they persuade me.

text: 但就是有一个问题，一个很严重的问题。
en: But there is one problem, a very serious one.

text: 那就是这两个论据同样适用于同类型的其他行为，比如：出轨、通奸、包二奶、养小三.......。
en: Namely, these two arguments apply equally to other behaviours of the same kind, such as: extramarital affairs, adultery, keeping a mistress, taking a lover….

text: 而这些行为却都是不违法的。
en: Yet all of these behaviours are not against the law.

text: 对于论据一，很多人支持卖淫嫖娼合法的人都避而不谈，或者转移话题。
en: As for the first argument, many who support legalising prostitution simply avoid the topic or change the subject.

text: 所以可以很容易猜测出，他们的回答和我一样，那就是不愿意。
en: So it is easy to guess that their answer is the same as mine: they are unwilling.

text: 但是，我也不愿意我老婆（老公）有出轨、通奸、包二奶、养小三等行为啊，那为什么这些行为不违法？
en: But I also would not want my wife (or husband) to have affairs, commit adultery, keep a mistress, take a lover, and so on — so why are these behaviours not illegal?

text: 实际上关于这一论据用更概括性的文字说就是卖淫嫖娼是违背传统道德、冲击公序良俗、不符合现在老百姓的朴素价值观的，所以大家都不希望自己的家人去做。
en: In fact, to put this argument in broader terms: prostitution violates traditional morality, undermines public order and moral norms, and runs counter to the simple values of ordinary people today, which is why no one wants their own family to do it.

text: 可问题是，出轨通奸养小三都是更违背传统道德、更冲击公序良俗、更不符合现在老百姓的朴素价值观的。
en: Yet the problem is that extramarital affairs, adultery, and taking lovers all violate traditional morality even more, undermine public order and moral norms even more, and run even more counter to the simple values of ordinary people today.

text: 可这些更恶劣的行为却都是不违法的。
en: Yet these even worse behaviours are all not against the law.

text: 再讨论论据二，对于论据二有很多人有不同看法，之所以如此，最大的原因就是新中国从没有过将卖淫嫖娼合法化过，所以缺少实践说明。
en: Turning to the second argument, many people hold different views on it. The main reason is that since the founding of New China, prostitution has never been legalised, so there is a lack of practical evidence.

text: 不过从逻辑上分析，我既不太赞同卖淫嫖娼合法化后一定会滋生更多其他犯罪，也不太赞同卖淫嫖娼合法化后一定会降低强奸率。
en: Still, from a logical analysis, I neither fully agree that legalising prostitution would necessarily breed more crime, nor fully agree that it would necessarily lower the rape rate.

text: 不过，对于出轨通奸养小三等行为是否会滋生其他恶性犯罪，那现实案例可太多了。
en: However, when it comes to whether affairs, adultery, and taking lovers breed other serious crimes, real-life cases are far too numerous to count.

text: 直接用“出轨和凶杀”做关键词搜百度，搜出来的近期因出轨引发的凶杀案就不胜枚举。
en: Simply searching Baidu with the keywords 'affair and homicide' brings up countless recent murder cases triggered by extramarital affairs.

text: 而出轨引发的其他犯罪如：故意伤害、敲诈勒索等那更是数不胜数。
en: And other crimes stemming from affairs — such as intentional bodily harm and extortion — are even more innumerable.

text: 所以，很明显，卖淫嫖娼是否会带来更多犯罪还不好确定。
en: So it is clear that whether prostitution leads to more crime remains uncertain.

text: 但出轨通奸等行为却完全可以确定会带来更多犯罪！
en: But it is absolutely certain that affairs and adultery lead to more crime!

text: 而且是恶性犯罪！
en: And serious crimes at that!

text: 然而这些行为却不违法。
en: Yet these behaviours are not against the law.

text: 更何况，与卖淫嫖娼不同的是，出轨、通奸、包二奶、养小三等行为，即使没有引发其他犯罪，至少至少，也伤害了第三者（出轨者的妻子、丈夫等）。
en: What is more, unlike prostitution, behaviours such as affairs, adultery, keeping a mistress, and taking a lover — even if they do not lead to other crimes — at the very least harm a third party (the adulterer's wife, husband, and so on).

text: 所以问题就出现了，无论从任何正大光明的理由来分析。
en: So the problem emerges, no matter what honourable justification one analyses it from.

text: 出轨、通奸、包二奶、养小三等行为相比卖淫嫖娼都更应该是违法的。
en: Behaviours such as affairs, adultery, keeping a mistress, and taking a lover should, compared with prostitution, all the more be illegal.

text: 既然这些更坏的行为不违法。
en: Since these worse behaviours are not against the law,

text: 那相对没那么坏的同类型的行为也不应该是违法的。
en: then the relatively less harmful behaviour of the same kind should not be illegal either.

text: 不用反驳，他们也就在知乎发泄发泄情绪而已了，甚至闹不到抖音上，国家也不可能干这种破坏形象还打自己脸的事。
en: No need to argue with them; they are just blowing off steam on Zhihu — they won't even take it to Douyin, and the state would never do something so damaging to its image and so self-defeating.

text: 卖淫合法，首先绝大多数女性会强烈反对，有机会有意愿组建家庭的人一般会反对，大体上支持国家的人也会反对。
en: If prostitution were legalised, first of all the great majority of women would strongly object; people who have the chance and wish to start a family would generally oppose it; and those who broadly support the state would also oppose it.

text: 这种事情合法化，绝对是对广大女同胞的羞辱，经历了几千年的性剥削，嘲笑和侮辱，在这种年代居然还会卖淫合法。
en: Legalising something like this would be an absolute humiliation of women everywhere; having endured thousands of years of sexual exploitation, mockery, and humiliation, in this day and age prostitution would actually be made legal.

text: 女同胞估计会反对非常强烈，不要说合法了，你在抖音提提试试，肯定被喷的狗血淋头。
en: Women would very likely oppose it vehemently; not even mentioning legalisation — just try bringing it up on Douyin and you would certainly be torn to pieces.

text: 现实里也是，你对这种人说你妈是鸡你爸是卖py的，他肯定会骂回去甚至打回去，因为他自己也没法发自内心的认为这可以作为一项合法工作，他也就是在知乎发泄情绪了。
en: It is the same in real life: if you say to such a person, 'your mum's a whore and your dad sells his arse,' he will definitely curse you out or even hit you, because even he cannot genuinely believe this could be a legitimate job; he is just blowing off steam on Zhihu.
